Prune subtrees coming from specific cases

Source: R/prune.R
prune.Rd

This function prunes a simulacr object by removing selected cases and all their downstream infections.

Usage

prune(x, ids = NULL, remove_stems = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A simulacr object as returned by simulate_outbreak().

ids

A vector of logical, integer, or character indicating the subset of cases for which subtrees should be removed. Defaults to NULL, in which case no pruning takes place.

remove_stems

A logical indicating if the cases from which subtrees are pruned should be removed as well. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A simulacr object.

Author

Thibaut Jombart

Examples

set.seed(123)
x <- simulate_outbreak(50, 10, tau = 0.05, w = c(0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1))
plot(x)


subtree(x) # list all subtrees
#> $HmPsw2
#>  [1] "Gr2Rn7" "YC7ktN" "f5NHoR" "oonRkd" "m5SVbK" "958gct" "yRJP0B" "ZDRDVL"
#>  [9] "eNMXjD" "9ZExbV" "LPouHx" "aGWmAP" "3fI64s" "koy66n"
#> 
#> $Gr2Rn7
#> [1] "958gct" "LPouHx"
#> 
#> $YC7ktN
#> [1] "9ZExbV" "aGWmAP" "3fI64s"
#> 
#> $oonRkd
#> [1] "koy66n"
#> 
#> $m5SVbK
#> [1] "yRJP0B"
#> 
#> $ZDRDVL
#> [1] "oonRkd" "koy66n"
#> 
#> $eNMXjD
#>  [1] "YC7ktN" "f5NHoR" "oonRkd" "m5SVbK" "yRJP0B" "ZDRDVL" "9ZExbV" "aGWmAP"
#>  [9] "3fI64s" "koy66n"
#> 
#> $LPouHx
#> [1] "958gct"
#> 
#> $`3fI64s`
#> [1] "aGWmAP"
#> 
res <- prune(x, "eNMXjD") # prune second largest subtree
plot(res)
